mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 42 degrees with clear skies by the Verona Area High School and we are currently seeing a First Quarter moon.

In city news, the police department reports that a school bus driver was arrested for O W I this past Thursday. Additionally, the city has updated its zoning and sign ordinance, and residents can use an interactive map to check their specific zoning district online.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with live music at both Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Tomorrow, you can check out Yoga at Insight Wellness, and starting Monday, the schedule is packed with trivia nights at Hop Haus and the Bogey Factory.

On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I. Officers responded to reports of dangerous driving and confirmed no injuries occurred during the incident.
Today's flavor of the day is the refreshing Mint Cookie. The store is currently closed, but it will open today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
